notes.denominators: n excludes warmup only; counts overlap (stop may also be early/error). All raw points retained.
notes.success: terminal stop AND endpoint_early explicitly false AND no client/server/hash error.
notes.latency: Success-only p50/p95; linear interpolation with explicit n. Same client monotonic ns only; no zero imputation.
notes.independence: Repeated timings are observations, not independent texts. Case IDs and exact reference texts counted separately.
notes.server: Same-clock monotonic_ns event edges. endpoint_wait starts at receipt of the frame containing VAD last_speech_sample, not reference last sound. Never sum stage percentiles.
notes.cer: logic.normalized_cer: NFKC, lowercase, remove Unicode punctuation and whitespace; no traditional/simplified conversion. Missing transcript/reference is null.
notes.workers: ASR call return event plus actual LLM/TTS thread-stop and TTS return evidence; unknown is not joined. Join does not mean resident weights freed.
notes.hashes: Compare input_pcm_sha256 with terminal.input_pcm_sha256, and output PCM likewise. input_sha256 hashes the WAV container and is never compared with PCM.
notes.browser: Web Audio render, device output estimate and acoustic loopback are separate. Missing measurements remain null.
notes.paired_consistency: Exact ASR/answer text and output sample equality within case_id+repeat, excluding warmup. Missing/duplicate modes are explicit. Differences may reflect content/segmentation changes; do not attribute every latency difference solely to waiting.
notes.tts_latin: Known Chinese TTS frontend limitation: en_callable=None may skip English. Count rounds containing Unicode Latin letters in actual answer text, excluding warmup, including failed rounds; no audio quality score is inferred.
notes.components: Independent and resident documents stay separate; only explicit warmup=false rows timed. Observed memory peak is sampled, not an allocation maximum.
